lead.question: 大选之后，帕特里克为什么连续三天去前首相家，反复追问同一个问题？
lead.warmup: 《新概念英语》第二册第83课《After the elections》讲了一个耐人寻味的小故事：前首相莱恩先生在大选中落败，退出政界、去了国外；他的狂热反对者帕特里克却接连三天跑到他家门口，向同一位值班警察问同样的问题。警察先是耐心回答，继而略感疑心，最后竟大发雷霆。学完本课，你会明白帕特里克真正的乐趣究竟在哪里。
goals: 掌握 former / defeat / fanatical / opponent / radical / suspicious / progressive 等核心词汇的用法。
学会 ex- 前缀（ex-Prime Minister）和 the same ... as 结构的表达。
体会过去时与过去完成时的对比，尤其是间接引语中 had gone 的用法。
能用省略式让步状语从句（Though a little suspicious, ...）进行简洁表达。
lead.summary: 本课围绕“大选之后”展开：前首相莱恩先生竞选失败，退出政界、移居国外。他的狂热反对者帕特里克出于幸灾乐祸，接连三天来到莱恩旧宅，向同一位值班警察反复打听同一个问题。警察从最初的耐心作答，到略感疑心，最终失去耐心、大声咆哮。篇末帕特里克一句“我就是喜欢听你说出这句话”，点明了他执意追问的真实动机，读来颇具讽刺意味。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：same 前接名词时须加定冠词 the，引出比较对象时用 as 而不用 like——the same question as yesterday。

questions.q: Why did Patrick keep on asking the same question?
questions.zh: 帕特里克为什么一再问同一个问题？
questions.a: Because he loved to hear the policeman say that Mr. Lane had been defeated and had gone abroad.
questions.aZh: 因为他就是喜欢听警察说出莱恩先生落选、出国去了那句话。
questions.hint: 答案见课文最后一句：'I know, but I love to hear you say it!'

questions.q: What happened to Mr. Wentworth Lane in the recent elections?
questions.zh: 在最近的大选中，温特沃兹·莱恩先生怎么了？
questions.a: He was defeated in the recent elections.
questions.aZh: 他在最近的大选中被击败了。
questions.hint: 见课文第一句 The former Prime Minister ... was defeated.

questions.q: What did the policeman tell Patrick when he first asked if Mr. Lane lived there?
questions.zh: 帕特里克第一次问莱恩先生是否住那里时，警察告诉他什么？
questions.a: He told him that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
questions.aZh: 他告诉他，这位前首相落选后已经出国去了。
questions.hint: 见课文第五句，注意间接引语中的过去完成时 had gone。

questions.q: How did the policeman react the third time Patrick asked the same question?
questions.zh: 帕特里克第三次问同样问题时，警察作何反应？
questions.a: He lost his temper and shouted that he had told him the day before and the day before that.
questions.aZh: 他火了，大声说他昨天和前天都已经告诉过他了。
questions.hint: 见课文 'This time, the policeman lost his temper.'

questions.q: Why does Patrick enjoy being told the same thing again and again?
questions.zh: 帕特里克为什么乐意一遍又一遍地听同样的话？
questions.a: As a fanatical opponent of Mr. Lane's party, he takes pleasure in the defeat of his political rival.
questions.aZh: 作为莱恩先生所在政党的狂热反对者，他从政敌的失败中获得了快感。
questions.hint: 结合第三句 'a fanatical opponent' 理解其动机。

exercises.q: 汉译英：前首相温特沃兹·莱恩先生在最近的大选中被击败了。
exercises.a: The former Prime Minister, Mr. Wentworth Lane, was defeated in the recent elections.

exercises.q: 句型转换：把 The ex-Prime Minister went abroad after his defeat. 改为用 since 引导、含过去完成时的句子。
exercises.a: Since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
exercises.note: since 引导用过去完成时

exercises.q: 用所给词的适当形式填空：My friend, Patrick, has always been a fanatical ______ (oppose) of Mr. Lane's Radical ______ (Progress) Party.
改错：Though a little suspicious, the policeman gave him same answer.
exercises.a: gave him the same answer（same 前须加定冠词 the）

exercises.q: 汉译英：他又问了一个和昨天完全相同的问题。
exercises.a: He asked exactly the same question as he had asked the day before.

exercises.q: 选词填空（temper / mood）：This time, the policeman lost his ______.
句型转换：用省略式让步状语从句合并 The policeman was a little suspicious. He still gave the same answer.
exercises.a: Though (a little) suspicious, the policeman still gave the same answer.
exercises.note: 让步从句省略主语和 be

quiz.q: 课文中 'the former Prime Minister' 的 former 意思是？
帕特里克一直是莱恩先生所在政党的什么？
课文中 suspicious 的意思是？
选词填空：The policeman told him that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister ______ abroad.
quiz.note: 间接引语中用过去完成时

quiz.q: 选词填空：He asked exactly the same question ______ he had asked the day before.
第三次被问同样的问题时，警察为什么发火了？
options: Because Patrick kept asking the same question.
Because Patrick refused to leave the house.
Because Patrick told him a lie.
